commands:
BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR"
COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || COMMON_DIR=""
GIT_DIR_PATH=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || GIT_DIR_PATH=""
echo "COMMON_DIR=$COMMON_DIR"
echo "GIT_DIR_PATH=$GIT_DIR_PATH"

ruff check lib/test/regenerate-artifacts.py 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== default run: STDOUT ==="; python3 lib/test/regenerate-artifacts.py 2>/tmp/ra_err.txt; echo "rc=$?"; echo "=== STDERR (progress) ==="; cat /tmp/ra_err.txt; echo "=== malformed override ==="; env DEVFLOW_ARTIFACT_ROW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=x python3 lib/test/regenerate-artifacts.py; echo "rc=$?"

python3 lib/test/regenerate-artifacts.py >.prflow/tmp/ra_out.txt 2>.prflow/tmp/ra_err.txt; echo "rc=$?"; echo "=== STDOUT (report) ==="; cat .prflow/tmp/ra_out.txt; echo "=== STDERR (progress) ==="; cat .prflow/tmp/ra_err.txt

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
